lookback_source.quote: Days—Enter the number of days therapy services were provided in the last 7 days.

lookback_notes: The item's own pages state a 7-day window ("in the last 7 days"), and the worked example on the same page refers to it as the "7-day look-back period." Under the general convention (rai-manual-v1.20.1, p. 2-21) the window is counted as the ARD plus the 6 previous calendar days, but the 7-day value itself comes from the item's page, not from the convention.

source.quote: Although a total of 50 minutes of respiratory therapy services were provided over the 7-day look-back period, there were not any days that respiratory therapy was provided for 15 minutes or more. Therefore, O0400D equals zero days.
